title: T3 native live tools checklist
prepared_from: source and local Ferrite Git metadata; no live T3 verification by this worker
execution_owner: parent agent; native UI and authorized Sol and Sonnet subscription runs remain with parent

fixtures.scratch: Independent disposable local Git repo or copy/clone; never edit the active Ferrite checkout

known_local_merged.title: The app owns the window’s frame

fixtures.limits: Local merge history establishes historical PR identity, not current remote availability/auth/checks/comments. Browser remote branch names do not establish current open PR IDs.

cases.title: Surface creation, activation, and duplicate avoidance
cases.entry: Add panel surface / Open a surface → Files, Diff, Terminal, Browser, Pull request
cases.fixture: Scratch thread A; panel initially closed
cases.steps: Open each applicable surface from its visible menu. Reopen the same file and PR. Click every resulting tab.
cases.assertions: Correct body under the selected title; no stale body from the previous surface; resource reopens activate rather than duplicate; unavailable choices explain why.
cases.cleanup: Close audit-created tabs; preserve any pre-existing tabs.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Surface identity includes the PR target. ThreadRightPanelState stores surfaces and activeSurfaceId. Reopening a resource must activate its existing identity.

cases.title: Per-thread panel target ownership
cases.entry: Two scratch thread rows; Add panel surface
cases.fixture: Scratch threads A and B with distinct filenames and terminal text
cases.steps: A opens Files and B opens Terminal. With A selected, click the PR badge on B. Repeat with B selected and its own badge. Exercise a linked PR count if available. Alternate threads and open resources again.
cases.assertions: The clicked row thread becomes the route when its PR opens in the right panel. Title, project, PR number, selected tab, and displayed body agree after every click. A hidden panel update with no route change fails.
cases.cleanup: Return to original selected thread; close only audit tabs.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: openPrLink receives the clicked row threadRef. If the panel opens on a non-route thread, onThreadActivate changes the route to that thread.

cases.title: Width and reopen sequence
cases.entry: Panel resize edge; Add panel surface; collapse/maximize controls
cases.fixture: Fresh scratch thread at recorded window size
cases.steps: Measure closed/open width. Drag compact, open Files→Browser→Diff→PR, collapse/reopen, switch thread and return. Maximize/restore once.
cases.assertions: User-chosen width survives appropriate transitions; no tool permanently enlarges the panel without a resize; conversation stays usable; drag follows pointer and finishes on outside release.
cases.cleanup: Restore original size and maximization.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: useResizableWidth persists widthStorageKey. Default width is 540, minimum is 360, and the maximum caps the viewport fraction and remaining chat width.

cases.title: Tabs support normal mouse and keyboard interactions
cases.entry: Tab context menu: Close, Close others, Close to the right, Close all; Scroll tabs left/right
cases.fixture: Only audit-created tabs in scratch thread
cases.steps: Overflow the strip with several files; inspect menus; test wheel/trackpad, keyboard focus, close button, and supported middle-click. Run close variants only on audit tabs.
cases.assertions: Active tab stays visible; close picks a sensible neighbor; tab close never selects an unrelated resource; focus and keyboard continue to work afterward.
cases.cleanup: Close remaining audit tabs.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Context items call close-one, close-others, close-to-right, and close-all callbacks. Middle click calls the close path. Keyboard and pointer activation must agree.

cases.title: Animation and reduced-motion contract
cases.entry: Settings → Appearance → Panel animations; Toggle main sidebar
cases.fixture: Scratch thread; record existing animation preference
cases.steps: Capture both left-sidebar and right-panel open and close at the recorded current setting. Set a nonzero local duration if needed to exercise the supported animation path. Reverse transitions rapidly, then restore the original setting. Record reduced-motion preference without changing the OS setting.
cases.assertions: Record actual default separately from available motion. No invisible hit target, stuck width, focus in a closed panel, or old content during reversal. Still screenshots cannot prove smoothness.
cases.cleanup: Restore duration and any changed reduced-motion preference; do not alter OS accessibility settings merely for this test.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: active requires a positive duration, no reduced-motion preference, and no navigation suppression. Closing retains the same scope value until the exit duration ends.
The source default is zero. First record the installed setting. Test positive-duration animation separately from the default.
Sidebar motion uses the configured duration and reduced-motion preference. Navigation suppression intentionally does not snap a closing sidebar sheet.

cases.title: Narrow window and focus routing
cases.entry: Window edge; panel resize handle; Tab / Escape / app keybindings
cases.fixture: Scratch thread with Files, PR or Terminal open
cases.steps: Resize around 980px and 760px source thresholds; traverse controls with keyboard; click composer after panel input and back.
cases.assertions: Inline/sheet switch is usable; no clipped action row, overlapping hit regions, lost draft, or shortcut stolen by hidden controls. Installed-version thresholds may differ and must be recorded.
cases.cleanup: Restore window geometry and input focus.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The chat panel passes its measured inline width and sheetAnimationDurationMs into the shared side-panel layout. Verify both inline and sheet modes.

cases.title: Standalone PR workspace is reachable
cases.entry: Pull requests; Refresh pull requests
cases.fixture: Read-only PR fixture project, initially no selected PR
cases.steps: Open the visible Pull requests navigation entry from a thread and from the home state; refresh once.
cases.assertions: List is accessible independently of a current branch PR; loading completes to real rows, honest empty state, or actionable error; current project/server scope is visible.
cases.cleanup: Restore prior view and filters.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The utility menu has an explicit route action for the standalone Pull requests page. Verify the page, selection, and history destination.

cases.title: Involvement and lifecycle filters are independent
cases.entry: All / Reviewing / Authored; All / Open / Closed / Merged
cases.fixture: Ferrite-origin scratch clone; known merged #189 and #187
cases.steps: Switch involvement and state independently. Use Merged to find known references, then restore.
cases.assertions: Rows match both filters; selected detail does not silently become a different PR; counts/empty explanation are coherent.
cases.cleanup: Restore prior involvement/state filters.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Involvement and state are separate option sets. Each selected filter must change only its own query field.

cases.title: Project, server, and host scopes do not leak selection
cases.entry: Filters → All projects / All servers; host selector
cases.fixture: Scratch project plus existing project only if already available
cases.steps: Select scratch project; inspect host/server scope; change filter while a PR detail is open.
cases.assertions: List filtering and selected PR identity are explicit; no same-number PR from another repo appears under stale header; unavailable project explains its state.
cases.cleanup: Restore scope; do not connect a new server.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The list scope key includes environment, assignment, state, involvement, project, host, draft, review, checks, author, and labels. Cached results must match that scope.

cases.title: Search works for number, text, and label syntax
cases.entry: Search pull requests; placeholder Search pull requests, or label:bug
cases.fixture: Known #189 and a visible row with a label, if available
cases.steps: Search number/title, a visible label: value, then a nonsense token; clear with normal keyboard editing.
cases.assertions: Results correspond to query; no-results is recoverable; typing does not trigger global shortcuts; clearing restores rows.
cases.cleanup: Clear audit query.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The input keeps a draft and reports the query through onChange. Test typed text, clear, label syntax, and the resulting list scope.

cases.title: Advanced filter combinations remain understandable
cases.entry: Filters → Drafts only / Hide drafts; Approved / Changes requested / Review required / No reviews; Passing / Failing; Author; Labels
cases.fixture: Available rows; record which facet values exist
cases.steps: Combine draft, review and check filters; search authors and labels; remove one filter at a time.
cases.assertions: Selected facets remain visible; labels do not collide; empty state says Nothing under these filters; clearing does not discard unrelated filters.
cases.cleanup: Restore every filter changed.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Menu controls represent independent draft, review, checks, author, and label fields. Facet choices and selected labels must survive reopening.

cases.title: Sorting states have visible meaning
cases.entry: Merge readiness / Blocked on me / Recently updated / Newest shown / Oldest shown / Largest shown / Smallest shown
cases.fixture: At least two real PR rows
cases.steps: Switch sort options; compare visible dates or change sizes and inspect grouped sections.
cases.assertions: Order matches label within available loaded results; a partial result set is not presented as exhaustive; selected row remains identifiable.
cases.cleanup: Restore previous sort.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The list provides explicit sort values. PullRequestsPage uses eager stats for ready, largest, and smallest, so wait for actual ordering before passing.

cases.title: List keyboard navigation opens the intended PR
cases.entry: PR rows; Search pull requests
cases.fixture: Known merged #189 and #187
cases.steps: Use keyboard to move through rows and open, then repeat with pointer; return/back and reopen.
cases.assertions: Focus is visible; selected PR number/repo matches the chosen row; no extra click needed; back restores useful list position.
cases.cleanup: Close only newly opened PR tabs.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The page keyboard handler operates on its displayed entries and current selection. Verify the selected PR identity after navigation, not only the row highlight.

cases.title: Multiple PR tabs remain distinct
cases.entry: PR row clicks; panel PR tabs; Close others
cases.fixture: Known #189 and #187 in same repo; second repo only if already available
cases.steps: Open both; alternate tabs; close one; reopen the same number.
cases.assertions: Distinct number/title/target; no duplicated or swapped body; correct tab survives closing; same-target reopen avoids unnecessary duplication.
cases.cleanup: Close audit PR tabs.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: A list entry opens a PR surface under the standalone page panel ref. Tabs must retain distinct target identities and selected bodies.

cases.title: Empty and unavailable projects have useful recovery
cases.entry: No projects in this workspace / No pull requests / Nothing under these filters / Pull requests unavailable
cases.fixture: A scratch repo without a remote; nonsense search for empty result
cases.steps: Observe no-remote and filtered-empty states without changing live auth; inspect offered navigation/retry links.
cases.assertions: Each condition is distinguished; no misleading spinner forever; recovery returns to list without losing user context.
cases.cleanup: Remove filters; leave live auth/config unchanged.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Empty rendering distinguishes the lack of projects, filtered-out entries, and no PRs. Recovery must change the cause, not only dismiss the message.

cases.title: Summary resolves the exact requested PR
cases.entry: Summary; PR number/repo header
cases.fixture: Known merged #189, optionally #187
cases.steps: Open detail from list. Compare number, repository, title, state, base/head, changed-file count and description to its visible list identity.
cases.assertions: Complete target identity; body has readable Markdown/code/links; merged state is settled rather than showing active merge affordance; data is not borrowed from prior tab.
cases.cleanup: Return to list or keep this audit PR for next cases.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Detail, activity, checks, cached snapshots, and shared summaries resolve under environment plus project, host, repository, and number. Confirm every visible field belongs to that key.

cases.title: Checks expand into actionable detail
cases.entry: Checks / Checks: <summary>; individual check row
cases.fixture: Real PR with at least one check; unavailable checks recorded as fixture gap
cases.steps: Open checks popover; inspect name, status, description and any outbound detail link; open one read-only detail destination if available.
cases.assertions: Summary matches individual rows; pending/failure/skipped are distinguishable; tooltip is not the only way to read essential data; link activates correct check.
cases.cleanup: Close popover and extra external tab.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The checks popover loads detail when opened and keeps showAll state. Confirm individual job identity, status, and outbound target.
The separate checks query requires server capability pullRequestChecks. Live refresh runs for an open PR with supported checks. A missing capability is not a proven UI failure.

cases.title: Native refresh updates the actual displayed review
cases.entry: More pull request actions → Refresh
cases.fixture: Known PR with loaded Summary and Timeline
cases.steps: Capture Summary, Timeline, and Code contents. Use Refresh and record loading and settled states. Compare a naturally changed read-only PR if one is available. Record checked-at or query evidence if safely exposed. A spinner alone cannot pass freshness.
cases.assertions: Detail and activity refresh under the same PR identity. Existing useful content remains or has clear loading status. Errors are visible. Check whether checks data revalidates through its separate query instead of assuming the Refresh button directly calls checks refresh. Unchanged static data alone cannot prove freshness.
cases.cleanup: Close menu; no host writes.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Explicit refresh invalidates the host cache, refreshes detail, activity, and stack, then increments refreshToken. Observe content or read evidence, not only the spinner.
A new refreshToken resets diff slices, forgets the applied page, and refreshes first-page diff and viewed-file data.

cases.title: Timeline preserves discussion structure
cases.entry: Timeline; Open activity on host; More replies if present
cases.fixture: A PR with comments/reviews/replies; inspect #189/#187 to choose
cases.steps: Read chronology, authored timestamps, review verdicts, resolved/outdated threads, replies, snippets and host link. Expand collapsed/reply groups.
cases.assertions: Order is coherent; replies remain attached to their thread; resolved/outdated state is visible; code context and Markdown remain readable.
cases.cleanup: Collapse optional expansions if restoring initial state matters.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Timeline builds activity events and keys review threads by resolution and dismissed state. Inspect grouped replies, collapsed discussions, and exact linked anchors.

cases.title: Timeline can attach context without sending
cases.entry: Timeline → Add to chat
cases.fixture: Scratch thread A and a comment/activity item
cases.steps: Use Add to chat, type a distinct audit note beside the resulting context, switch away/back, then remove the attachment.
cases.assertions: Attached item retains PR/repo/activity identity and user annotation; composer input remains editable; no prompt is sent automatically.
cases.cleanup: Delete only audit draft text and context attachment.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The button passes the selected comment into local chat context. The composer must retain the comment target and additional typed text.

cases.title: Code tab presents the correct whole change
cases.entry: Code; Diff scope: All commits
cases.fixture: Known merged PR with multiple changed files
cases.steps: Open Code, browse file tree, collapse/expand files, switch between All commits and one visible commit.
cases.assertions: Hunks/path/additions/deletions correspond to selected scope; target label updates; unavailable/truncated portions are explicit.
cases.cleanup: Restore All commits and original file selection.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Diff slices belong to the current PR and commit scope. Changing the scope must not retain files or comments from a previous PR.

cases.title: PR diff remains usable at realistic widths
cases.entry: Diff layout; Stacked diff view / Split diff view; Enable diff line wrapping; Hide test files; Show file tree
cases.fixture: Known PR with long lines and test files if available
cases.steps: Toggle each presentation control, drag explorer width with pointer and keyboard, navigate a distant file, then resize panel.
cases.assertions: No horizontal content traps or missing line numbers; active file follows selection; wrapping/test filtering affects only intended display.
cases.cleanup: Restore layout/wrapping/tree/test-filter settings.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Fold, wrapping, file-tree, hidden-test, and selection state are distinct. Verify content and scroll after each view change.

cases.title: Viewed state distinguishes local and host persistence
cases.entry: Viewed / Changed; These ticks are kept here, not on the host
cases.fixture: Known read-only PR
cases.steps: Inspect viewed controls and locality notice. Do not toggle when it would mark viewed on the host. If explicitly local-only, toggle one file, navigate away/back, then restore.
cases.assertions: A local-only tick is honestly labelled; changed-since-viewed is distinct; hidden files do not misstate completion.
cases.cleanup: Undo local tick; no host viewed-state mutation.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Viewed-file storage is a capability value. A host-backed toggle can write remotely. Only exercise a positively identified local-only viewed store during the read-only pass.

cases.title: Review draft supports text, verdict and preview without submission
cases.entry: Review summary; Review verdict → Comment / Approve / Request changes; Submit review
cases.fixture: Known PR where review form is offered; scratch context
cases.steps: Enter a clearly synthetic draft, switch offered verdicts, inspect validation and Markdown preview if present. Navigate within PR and return. Never press submit shortcut or Submit review.
cases.assertions: Draft text survives harmless tab changes; required summary rule is clear; disabled submit is understandable; permission/self-review restriction is explicit.
cases.cleanup: Clear audit review draft and inline drafts; verify no posted activity.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: summaries and drafts are keyed by pullRequestReviewKey. requestedVerdict is local. submit calls pullRequestEnvironment.submitReview and then clears submitted draft data only after success.

cases.title: Inline review comments retain range and typed note
cases.entry: Code line selection / comment affordance; Add to agent
cases.fixture: Known PR with text diff
cases.steps: Select a single changed line and multi-line range; open comment editor; type a note; inspect add-to-review vs agent context actions. Use only local draft action.
cases.assertions: Correct path and side/range are retained; quote/context and typed text coexist; switching files does not silently drop local draft.
cases.cleanup: Remove audit inline drafts and composer attachments; never publish.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Inline host comments require capability and permission and only work on the whole-change scope. Agent context is local and can remain available without host comment permission.

cases.title: Comment composer is readable and cancel-safe
cases.entry: Leave a comment; Write / Preview; comment submit control
cases.fixture: Known PR with comment permission
cases.steps: Type synthetic Markdown with a link and code; switch Write/Preview; inspect mention completion if offered. Do not submit or use submit keyboard chord.
cases.assertions: Preview corresponds to text; focus returns to editor; no submission on ordinary Enter; input state persists only as expected.
cases.cleanup: Clear text and close editor; confirm Timeline unchanged.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Comment body is local until the submit handler calls the host. The submitting mode distinguishes comment, close, and reopen.
Write and Preview share the draft. Changing previews must not drop text or trigger submission.

cases.title: Edit/reply/resolve controls do not masquerade as local UI
cases.entry: Edit comment; reply field; Resolve thread / reopen control if offered
cases.fixture: Existing PR activity, preferably own comment only if one already exists
cases.steps: Inspect available controls, permission hints and draft editors. Do not save, react, resolve, reopen, or edit someone else’s content.
cases.assertions: Controls are scoped to correct item; edit/reply drafts have visible cancel; unavailable operations are explained rather than dead links.
cases.cleanup: Cancel editors; verify no new or changed activity.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Editing and saving are separate states. Comment edits, reactions, and thread resolution cross the host mutation boundary.

cases.title: PR links support normal browser/context behavior
cases.entry: PR context menu: Copy link; Open on GitHub. Markdown HTTP link: Open in integrated browser; Open in system browser; Copy Link.
cases.fixture: Known merged PR and scratch composer containing its URL
cases.steps: Right-click the PR badge and a normal Markdown HTTP link. Select each supported read-only open action once and verify the actual URL. Copy the link and inspect its value without exposing unrelated clipboard history. Test modifier click separately.
cases.assertions: Normal click opens intended native target when configured; external path remains available; copy result matches exact URL/number; right-click does more than inert underline.
cases.cleanup: Close external audit tab; restore preference and clipboard if needed.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The menu separates open-on-host from Copy link and Copy reference. Verify each destination and the native context menu independently.
The PR context menu offers Copy link and Open on the host. The open-external branch calls api.shell.openExternal with the clicked URL.
HTTP links offer Open in integrated browser when available, Open in system browser, and Copy Link. Each action calls a distinct handler.

cases.title: Link PR dialog validates and targets the chosen thread
cases.entry: Link pull request; Pull request URL or #42; Choose a thread
cases.fixture: Scratch thread only; known #189 URL
cases.steps: Open Link pull request; try malformed text then valid full URL; inspect target repo/number. Link only to scratch thread if supported, switch threads, and inspect linked indicator.
cases.assertions: Malformed input produces inline validation; valid absolute URL avoids ambiguous repo; linked badge reveals correct native PR from another selected thread.
cases.cleanup: Unlink scratch association if offered or remove scratch thread during cleanup; never link existing user thread.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Validation resolves URL or number against the target thread project. The linking command must use that threadRef and environment.

cases.title: Linked threads and stacks navigate correctly
cases.entry: Linked pull requests; linked-thread count; Stack <n>, layer <n>; Retry stack refresh
cases.fixture: Scratch linked PR; real stack only if already present
cases.steps: Open linked PR collection, navigate linked thread, inspect stack layer/menu if available.
cases.assertions: Links preserve selected repo and environment; layer navigation updates detail; unavailable stack explains retry without dumping the user elsewhere.
cases.cleanup: Close audit linked panels; restore selection.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Relations are environment-scoped and filtered to visible threads. Link changes are local T3 relations, while navigation must target the selected related thread.
Stacks require server support and detail capabilities stacks and stackActions. Native stack membership can own the merge route.

cases.title: Mutation menus expose honest state and cancel correctly
cases.entry: More pull request actions; Merge now → Confirm merge?; Close pull request → Confirm close?; Revert changes → Confirm revert?
cases.fixture: Real PR appropriate to state; no mutation authorization
cases.steps: Inspect menu first. Only where source and visible UI both show a two-step arm, arm once and dismiss with Escape/outside click. Reopen to verify disarmed state.
cases.assertions: Correct PR target remains visible; arm is explicit and resets on dismissal/navigation; no mutation occurs. Ready for review, Convert to draft, Reopen, Disable auto-merge and Allow edits from maintainers are immediate writes: do not click.
cases.cleanup: Dismiss all menus; verify original state unchanged.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Some actions arm an inline confirmation. Maintainer edits issue update immediately. Inspect each handler boundary before clicking an enabled action.

cases.title: Checkout choices disclose their destination
cases.entry: Check out → In a separate worktree / In this repository
cases.fixture: Read-only PR fixture project
cases.steps: Open the checkout menu and inspect environment and destination choices. Dismiss before checkout. An optional actual checkout is a separate parent-owned local-reversible test restricted to the disposable clone.
cases.assertions: Separate worktree and current repository are visibly different; pending/error state has a clear destination; no silent change to source checkout.
cases.cleanup: Cancel menu; if parent explicitly runs scratch checkout, track worktree path and remove only after thread closure.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The worktree and local choices call onCheckout with different modes. The menu is disabled without checkoutRoot or while a handoff is active.

cases.title: Agent handoffs preserve PR context
cases.entry: Ask a question; Explain this PR; Fix findings; Write guide / Rewrite guide
cases.fixture: Scratch thread; parent-controlled Sol session only
cases.steps: Inspect labels first. Ask a question may attach context; verify behavior before typing. Explain/Fix/Write guide can start an agent immediately and must be exercised only by parent with chosen provider.
cases.assertions: Handoff names exact repo/PR; correct scratch thread opens; live progress and cancellation are visible; no publishing/forge writes requested.
cases.cleanup: Stop and close any parent-created agent/thread; remove audit attachments.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Handoff state prevents duplicate preparation. Composer context and automatic agent starts are separate outcomes. Parent owns any model run and thread cleanup.

cases.title: Guide empty, running, stopped and stale states
cases.entry: Guide; Write guide / Rewrite; Rewrite
cases.fixture: Existing guide preferred; parent-controlled generation if required
cases.steps: Read an existing guide and navigate its stops/excerpts. Inspect empty-state writer choice. Parent may run one bounded guide only under intended subscription/provider.
cases.assertions: Guide stays tied to PR head; stop selection reveals correct files/ranges; running and failed states are visible; stale guide is marked after changed head if safely observable.
cases.cleanup: Cancel active run; close generated scratch thread; do not leave background generation.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Guide content, loading, failure, and running state come from the guide query and run state. Inspect available states and let the parent own any generation.
The coordinator tracks running watches and handles guide updates. Closing the tab must not be treated as proof that generation stopped.

cases.title: PR list/detail errors recover without losing usable content
cases.entry: Pull requests unavailable; Refresh; More pull request actions → Refresh
cases.fixture: Naturally disconnected/unavailable project or read-only nonexistent PR URL in scratch context
cases.steps: Use malformed Link PR input for client validation; use nonexistent reference only for read-only missing-resource behavior. Never revoke credentials or disconnect user environment to manufacture failure.
cases.assertions: Error is specific, wrapped and actionable; previously loaded list can remain with stale notice; retry works if prerequisite restored; wrong-repo errors never show stale previous PR as current.
cases.cleanup: Remove scratch invalid reference; restore selection.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: The workspace retains loaded snapshots through refresh and host read errors. Check the visible stale-data notice and whether old rows remain usable.
The unavailable component receives the error and recovery action. Exercise only a safe missing reference or naturally unavailable connection.

cases.title: Diff/activity failures have local retry and external escape
cases.entry: Could not load pull request activity → Retry; Try again; Open on GitHub; Technical details
cases.fixture: Natural missing/oversized/unavailable content only, otherwise fixture-blocked
cases.steps: If error occurs, expand technical details and use retry; open the PR externally read-only; resize panel.
cases.assertions: Summary, cause, remedy, and long details remain readable; retry is actionable; no clipped line with hidden remedy; already loaded content is not incorrectly cleared elsewhere.
cases.cleanup: Close details and extra external tab.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Activity failure has its own retry. Detail loading success does not establish Timeline success.
Diff failure exposes a retry, an external target, and technical details. Test text wrapping and target preservation.

cases.title: Files entry and tree navigation
cases.entry: Add panel surface → Files; Search files; Refresh workspace files
cases.fixture: Scratch tree with nested folders and duplicate filenames
cases.steps: Open tree, expand/collapse nested folders with pointer and arrows, search relative name/path, clear, refresh.
cases.assertions: No blank tree after refresh; indentation and selection are clear; duplicate basenames remain distinguishable; keyboard expands a folder without accidental file open.
cases.cleanup: Clear search and restore expansion if needed.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: File tree search and expansion use environment plus cwd. Refresh must update the directory data and selected file without navigating to another checkout.

cases.title: Open files and navigate retained breadcrumbs
cases.entry: File row; File contents; breadcrumb folders
cases.fixture: Scratch nested src/sample.ts and docs/sample.ts
cases.steps: Open both files; traverse parent breadcrumbs and a retained child; click file links with line targets when available.
cases.assertions: Correct full path/content shown; repeated opens do not duplicate unnecessarily; line target is visible and highlighted, not only scrolled somewhere nearby.
cases.cleanup: Close file tabs.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: relativePath, revealLine, and revealRequestId identify the requested file and location. Same basenames and repeated line opens must retain correct context.

cases.title: Large file and long-line behavior
cases.entry: Enable word wrap / Disable word wrap; source view
cases.fixture: Scratch long-lines.txt and a large generated text file; no private files
cases.steps: Open each, scroll rapidly, select/copy near top and lower region, resize narrow/wide, toggle wrapping.
cases.assertions: No missing text, jumps to wrong position, unusable horizontal trap, or misleading truncation; any first-1MB limit is explicit.
cases.cleanup: Close files; restore wrapping.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Large text uses a separate preview with saving, revision, and loaded URL state. Verify the supported limit and recovery from a failed load.

cases.title: Markdown and delimited data have useful alternate views
cases.entry: Rendered/source toggle; Full file; CSV table view
cases.fixture: Scratch Markdown with table/code/link/task-list and small CSV/TSV
cases.steps: Switch rendered/source views; follow a local link; test table scroll and copy; inspect Markdown task checkbox without editing source user data.
cases.assertions: Rendering and source agree; tables fit/scroll; external/local links keep their meaning; toggles do not lose selected file or scroll unexpectedly.
cases.cleanup: Restore display preference; any checkbox edit only in scratch and undo afterward.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Markdown and table view choices persist separately. Switching representation must keep the file target and text intact.

cases.title: Media/document previews have finished loading/error states
cases.entry: Files → image, PDF, audio/video, office/font/binary preview as fixture permits
cases.fixture: Public/synthetic local files only; representative files created by parent if available
cases.steps: Open representative supported types, zoom/pan/page/play where visible, then malformed file and missing path.
cases.assertions: Correct preview vs unsupported explanation; text does not spill; loading/error controls remain reachable; unsupported does not appear as blank.
cases.cleanup: Pause media; close viewers; no external upload.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Each media or document renderer handles a resolved resource. Verify supported content, failure state, and width on the installed platform.

cases.title: Local file editing saves the intended file
cases.entry: File contents editor; normal save chord; pending/unsaved indicator
cases.fixture: Scratch text file with known marker only
cases.steps: Edit one marker, save, switch file and back, reopen after tab close. Then make unsaved edit and attempt close to inspect dismissal choices.
cases.assertions: Saved bytes appear on reread; unsaved/pending/error status is visible; close behavior preserves or explicitly discards draft; editing never leaks into composer.
cases.cleanup: Restore scratch marker or discard audit draft; close file.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Edits enter useFileSaveSession using environment, cwd, and relativePath. Confirm the scratch file bytes after save and after an unsaved-close decision.

cases.title: File context and dragging attach usable context
cases.entry: File context → Copy mention / Add to chat; drag file into composer

Delete now invokes cleanup across its selected scope. Do not click during this read-only pass.

cases.cleanup: Leave flags unchanged.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Labs exposes gated settings. Record visible availability and explanatory text without enabling capabilities or guest access.

cases.cleanup: Close/delete only audit capture if not needed as evidence; restore preferences.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Archive list navigation is read-only. Unarchive and Delete are write actions scoped to a specific thread.

cases.entry: Browser tab; Add panel surface → Browser; address field
cases.fixture: Controlled local/static page; scratch Files and PR tabs

cases.assertions: Correct surface stays active; browser controls stable during load; panel does not become disproportionately wide; user inputs act on visible surface.
cases.cleanup: Close audit page tabs; stop parent local server when unused.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: PR tabs resolve their native target separately from Browser tabs. Opening a URL must not replace or duplicate an unrelated PR or file.
HTTP links offer Open in integrated browser when available, Open in system browser, and Copy Link. Each action calls a distinct handler.
The selected link preference, modifiers, target thread, and in-app availability decide the destination. App-open failure can fall back to the system browser.

cases.title: Side chat can be opened and dismissed without losing parent draft
cases.entry: Add panel surface → Side chat
cases.fixture: Scratch parent thread; parent controls any Sol request
cases.steps: Open empty side chat, type unsent marker, switch panel/thread, return, close with unsaved text. Actual send only by parent.
cases.assertions: Parent and side-chat drafts separate; target/model context visible; close/reopen behavior honest; no background run starts from opening alone.
cases.cleanup: Discard audit draft; stop/close any parent-started side-chat agent.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Opening can fork a side-chat thread. A nonempty prompt also starts a turn. Track the child even when no model call occurs, then clean it up.
Side chat has its own scoped thread and explicit parent. Bring back and Delete are separate actions, not equivalents of closing the panel.

cases.title: Subagent and background surfaces are distinct
cases.entry: Visible agent/subagent row; live-output or background-work control
cases.fixture: Parent creates one bounded Sol-run child/background fixture if supported
cases.steps: Open child while streaming, select live output, navigate parent/back, close/reopen child tab, inspect nested agent if available.
cases.assertions: The clicked child identity and transcript match. Provider-supported output updates appear before completion. The live-output action does not navigate to an unrelated empty Background view. Claude completed tool output is distinct from Codex streamed tool output. Reopening retains content and parent navigation returns to the correct thread.
cases.cleanup: Parent stops every created child and background process; verify closed.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Provider-native children have their own thread identity and status. Their read-only bar replaces the composer. Background tasks are derived separately from the projection.
Live status derives from isOrchestrationV2WorkActive. Parent must verify child output, parent navigation, status completion, and provider cleanup independently.
Codex declares streaming tool output, native subagent thread IDs, wait, close, and fork support. Record the actual installed provider and model before using this contract.

Claude declares assistant and reasoning streaming, no streaming tool output, and completed tool output. It emits subagent lifecycle but does not expose native child IDs or native wait, close, or fork capabilities.
An asynchronous Agent launch acknowledgement does not settle a Claude child. The task notification supplies the completion event.
A Codex native child running item updates its parent subagent progress row. Repeated identical progress is not emitted again.

Authorized Sonnet selection mapped to the observed Claude provider instance

cases.assertions: Correct thread/surface becomes visible on first action; toast does not obscure composer/panel controls; dismiss does not accidentally submit or select underlying UI.
cases.cleanup: Resolve/cancel audit prompt and stop run; clear only audit notifications.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Notifications retain environmentId and threadId. Clicking navigates through buildThreadRouteParams. Validate the destination before testing any follow-up action.

cases.steps: Open the same Files/Diff/PR/settings target through palette and visible controls; keyboard-select and Escape/back.
cases.assertions: Same target and state; no hidden-thread routing; shortcuts usable with panel open; existing drafts and scroll position preserved.
cases.cleanup: Close palette and audit surfaces.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Command search, browse navigation, and add-project flows have separate state. Compare resulting scoped destinations with their visible-button equivalents.

cases.title: Final reopen/resume audit catches half-finished persistence
cases.entry: Thread switching; close/reopen surface; app restart only if parent has authorized/planned one
cases.fixture: Completed scratch A/B flows; tracked owned processes
cases.steps: Revisit every used surface from a different thread, then after closing its tab; where restart is in scope, capture state before/after.
cases.assertions: No named but blank tab; no stale target or unexpected massive width; pending/failed operations explained; no orphan activity silently continues.
cases.cleanup: Complete global cleanup ledger below.

source_bindings.state_or_branch: Persisted panel state restores valid per-thread resources and excludes the standalone PR panel key. Distinguish intended persistence from leftover audit work.

principles.name: Prove It Works
principles.choice: Every case stays not-run until the parent observes its asserted UI result. Source existence cannot produce a pass.

skill_application.delegation: No further explorers or explainers. Parent explicitly prohibited more agents.

source_correlation_rule: Before each actual test, read the cited implementation and record the installed app version. After the action, record matching runtime target, content, and state. If source and installed build differ, label version mismatch; do not infer a defect solely from the pinned source.

provider_contracts.shared-client: Client-side interaction does not by itself prove any provider workflow. Record selected environment and any capability-gated UI. Run once per relevant layout, with provider repetition only when the observed path depends on provider state.
provider_contracts.host-capabilities: The safe real fixture is GitHub. Do not generalize it to other hosts. sourceControlClients supplies terminology and URL parsing. GitLab uses MR and merge request. PullRequestDetail.capabilities and viewerPermissions decide comments, reviews, edits, viewed storage, stacks, and actions. Server pullRequestChecks gates the checks query. Lack of a permission or capability is fixture-blocked unless the UI misrepresents it.
provider_contracts.agent-provider: Parent may use the authorized Sol and Sonnet subscriptions in T3. Record the actual provider instance, model, effort, account kind without identity or secrets, and child/thread IDs. Do not infer one provider stream from the other. A provider-native child is not necessarily an independently writable chat.
provider_contracts.host-and-agent: Apply both host-capabilities and agent-provider. Record the host PR identity and agent destination. Preparing a worktree, attaching context, and automatically starting a turn are separate actions.
provider_contracts.environment-capabilities: File access, terminal availability, and device or remote execution depend on the selected environment and its granted scopes. A local scratch success does not prove remote behavior. Use existing safe remote fixtures only, otherwise label the remote variant fixture-blocked.

provider_contract_sources.state_or_branch: Registry includes GitHub, Cursor Origin, GitLab, GitCafe, Forgejo, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps. URL and remote recognition order differ.
GitLab labels are MR and merge request.
Server checks capability and source-control write scope alter available detail actions.
Host review capabilities, viewer permissions, and viewed-file storage must be recorded per fixture.
Provider-native subagents do not accept composer messages. Their approvals and questions go to the top-level parent.

evidence_requirements.before: Case ID, installed T3 version, selected environment/project/thread or draft, model/provider if applicable, current URL or PR number, panel state, and full-window screenshot.
evidence_requirements.action: Exact visible label, input text without secrets, pointer or keyboard method, and time. Use a normal rendered control. Direct store mutation or helper calls cannot pass a native journey.
evidence_requirements.after: Full-window screenshot plus relevant close-up, resulting route and selected thread, active tab, content identity, loading/settled state, and any error. Include actual saved bytes or process state when the assertion needs them.
evidence_requirements.motion: Capture a frame sequence or video for opening, closing, and reversal. Still before/after images only prove end states. Record animation setting and reduced-motion state.
evidence_requirements.source_match: Read the cited symbol before running the case. Record which handler/state matches the observed result. A source-installed-version mismatch stays a separate uncertainty.
evidence_requirements.failure: Repeat once from a known state if safe. Preserve precise steps and targets. Record reproduction count and whether the failure is functional, visual, interaction, provider capability, fixture-blocked, or version mismatch.
evidence_requirements.cleanup: Record every created thread, draft, child, terminal/process, tab, checkout/worktree, project entry, file, and changed preference. Confirm stopped/closed/restored state directly. Closing a tab does not prove a process stopped.

safe_fixture_recipe: Create two audit-named scratch threads in an independent disposable local Git repository. Use unique text markers per thread and file.

For real read-only PR data, use an independent disposable local clone or copy of Ferrite with its GitHub origin. Keep active Ferrite checkout untouched. The local merge history identifies PR 189 and PR 187 without any host write.
Before opening a Git-backed project, inspect Automatically pull and other background source-control defaults. The disposable clone contains any checkout changes or fetches.

Prepare nested files with duplicate basenames, Markdown, CSV or TSV, a long line, and a large text file. Add baseline commits and known staged, unstaged, renamed, deleted, and untracked scratch changes.
Use available tiny media fixtures for previews. If a format requires an unavailable renderer or permission, record that branch as fixture-blocked. Do not install tools just to manufacture coverage.
Use harmless terminal commands that print distinct markers and cwd. Any running-process test uses an audit-owned short-lived process. Track its PID and terminal ID.

Use only naturally available read-only PR changes for refresh freshness. Use empty filters, invalid input, or a nonexistent read-only reference for safe error paths. Do not log out, remove credentials, or disconnect user environments.
Parent owns all Sol and Sonnet turns, subagents, guides, handoffs, cancellation, and thread closure. No model was run by the checklist author.
